title: Handover Standards for Ridgeline Orders & Delivery: Signatures, Photo Proof, Inspection and Reporting Periods
content:
How a Ridgeline Orders & Delivery order is handed over, and how long the customer has to report a problem afterwards, is set per fulfillment program as follows.

| Standard | Ridgeline Ship to Home | Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | Ridgeline Ship to Store | Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Delivery requires the signature of an adult at the address | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Merchandise total above which a shipped order requires a signature | $500.00 | $0.00 (never) | $0.00 (never) | $500.00 | $0.00 (never) | $0.00 (never) |
| Driver records a photo at delivery as proof | Yes | No | No | Yes | No | No |
| Customer inspects the item with the crew and may refuse a damaged item at the door | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Hours after delivery within which damage to a delivered appliance must be reported | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 48 |
| Days after the promised date within which a shipped order reported not received is investigated and replaced or refunded (calendar days) | 30 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Standards explained

- **Adult signature.** "Yes" in the first row means the delivery requires the signature of an adult at the address.
- **Signature threshold for shipped orders.** A shipped order whose merchandise total is above the figure shown requires a signature; a figure of $0.00 means a shipped order never requires one on this basis. A Ridgeline Ship to Home order of exactly $500.00 is not above the figure; one of $500.01 is.
- **Photo proof.** "Yes" means the driver records a photo at delivery as proof of delivery.
- **Inspection at the door.** "Yes" means the customer inspects the item with the crew and may refuse a damaged item at the door.
- **Appliance damage reporting.** Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away sets 48 hours after delivery as the period within which damage to a delivered appliance must be reported. A report made 20 hours after delivery falls within it; one made 60 hours after delivery does not.
- **Not-received reports.** Ridgeline Ship to Home sets 30 calendar days after the promised date as the period within which a shipped order reported not received is investigated and replaced or refunded. For an order promised for 2026-06-01, a report on 2026-06-19 falls within it; a report on 2026-07-15 does not.

Order totals, hours and dates used in the explanations are illustrative inputs only.
